description: Opt-out dengan panduan untuk Nuwber. Seseorang mengikuti langkah-langkah pada daftar periksa; OpenOptOut menyediakan alamat email sekali pakai dan mengeklik tautan konfirmasi.
instructions: Find your page on nuwber.com (searching {full_name} and filtering by {state} helps) and copy its address. Buka nuwber.com/removal/link, paste it, and enter {contact_email} as the email address. Nuwber emails a link to confirm; OpenOptOut clicks it for you. Kemudian tekan "Saya sudah melakukan ini". If the form won't take the address, email support@nuwber.com with a screenshot of your listing and ask to be removed.
